notes: Easy Windows install: Windows: one double-click installs everything. No Python download, no settings to change: if your PC has no Python, the installer fetches its own copy and checks its fingerprint first. It then opens the app by itself and adds icons to the Desktop and Start menu. Windows: the app now lives in your user folder (AppData\Local\Odds and Whiskers), so you can delete the download afterwards. Running the installer again repairs it without touching your settings, key or data. Two tutorials: a Quick tour (the essentials, about a minute) and a Full tour (every part of the app, about five minutes). Pick one from Help → Show me around or Settings → General.
